## Teaching-quality checks

Complete the relevant items:

- [ ] Official curriculum/provenance remains correct.
- [ ] No future concept is required before it is introduced.
- [ ] Student-facing material has enough context to stand on its own.
- [ ] Teacher-only answers, hints, lifecycle text, and review notes do not leak into student outputs.
- [ ] Student-facing visuals were rendered and inspected when changed.
- [ ] Practical/assessment answers were independently verified where applicable.
- [ ] Accessibility and paper/offline fallback were considered where applicable.

## Privacy and repository hygiene

- [ ] No student-identifiable information is included.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, secrets, or private assessment data are included.
- [ ] No raw official PDFs or past-paper PDFs were accidentally added.
- [ ] Generated local outputs and caches remain excluded unless intentionally versioned.
- [ ] External visual assets have licence/provenance information where required.
